_comment: Round 6 knob audition. Base = round-5 clip 01 settings with the pad/melody words stripped out. Exactly ONE knob changes per clip vs 00. Every clip carries the same seed so the knob is the only intended variable -- clip 07 re-renders the base to test whether that actually holds. Run: ~/.venvs/lyria/bin/python lyria/render.py --batch lyria/batch-round6.json --out-dir out6
